review_evidence: Reviewed all six primary Lean files. The source contains a large synthetic-Euclidean development, explicit geometry axioms, supporting tactics with geometric lemmas, a changes module, and a test module exercising the formal geometry.
A declaration scan across the hydrated source found 333 definition/theorem/lemma/structure/class-style declarations, including area, collinearity, triangle, same-side and parallelism lemmas.

Although lakefile.lean is build configuration, the unit is small and the remaining files carry substantial unique formal geometry; no repository-local hard exclusion was necessary to complete this unit.
summary: Reviewed the complete synthetic Euclidean geometry source; its primary files contain substantial formal definitions, axioms, lemmas and tactic-supported geometry, so the unit is retained.
